The study is nearing its planned end date. Discussions now centre on Objective 2 (new formats) and Objective 3 (version control and repository solutions). Updates are provided at joint TSG SA/RAN/CT plenaries, where the latest TR 21.802 draft is reviewed and approved. An extension of six months beyond TSG #111 (March 2026) is currently proposed: There was a proposal to extend the study, with a clear preference from many companies for an extension rather than concluding in March 2026. A 6-month extension was considered more reasonable than a 3-month one, given PCG timing. Any extension would require SID revision and approval at TSG#111 and would be used to develop and trial concrete, reproducible working solutions (e.g. via playgrounds and limited real-meeting trials).
